newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Buenos Aires city to sell $500 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Buenos Aires city to sell $500 mln debt.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank has been chosen to be the consultant for and lead manage a debt program of up to $500 million by the Argentine capital city of Buenos Aires, officials said Thursday.

Chase was chosen out of a group of nine banks. It will be charged with organizing a program of issues which may include "sydnicated loans, Eurobonds and or local debt issues of up to $500 million," the city's bank, Banco de la Ciudad be Buenos Aires, said.
The funds from the issues will be used to reschedule the city's debt and increase the capital base of Banco de la Ciudad.
